technical.summary: Mixed bullish technicals with strong short-term momentum (RSI, three white soldiers, supertrend) but conflicting overbought conditions and price below key moving averages limit conviction for swing entry.

fundamental.summary: FAST shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk within 41 days.

sentiment.summary: Market fear (30 VIX-equivalent) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but congressional activity is stale and mixed with no recent conviction signals.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (401.76) with flat yield curve and imminent NFP event create severe macro headwinds; earnings in 41 days adds moderate event risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Strong short-term momentum (three white soldiers, RSI bullish, supertrend, PSAR) with price near support (23.4987) offers contrarian entry in fear-driven market.
debate.key_bear_argument: Macro crisis regime (VIX 401.76), price below all key moving averages (50/200 SMA/EMA), overbought oscillators, negative CMF/AO, and high earnings risk in 41 days create excessive headwinds that outweigh short-term technicals.

decision.entry_rationale: While price sits at support with strong short-term momentum signals (three white soldiers, RSI bullish, supertrend), the macro crisis regime (VIX 401.76), price below all key moving averages, and high earnings risk in 41 days create excessive headwinds that outweigh tactical entry merit.
decision.primary_risk: Extreme VIX crisis environment combined with imminent earnings event (41 days) and negative macro backdrop (flat yield curve, NFP event) could trigger sharp reversal despite current support level.
decision.agent_agreement: moderate — technicals bullish but fundamentals, risk, and debate all favor bear case; sentiment contrarian signal insufficient to override macro crisis and earnings proximity
